productionChange.description: Allow ROUTINE alongside the four existing weekly schedule types in parseBackup; backup versions and schema unchanged.

coverage: COLLEGE, WORK, STUDY, PERSONAL and ROUTINE retain schedules and daily logs in schema versions 1 and 2
Repository export and restore recovers a ROUTINE schedule and its daily logs after deletion in the in-memory test database
